title: a-unit-a-test-run-starts-is-the-runs
intention: A systemd unit the launcher starts inside a test run carries the run's test id and collects itself if it fails, so the tester's kill reaches it and a killed run leaves no unit in the live user manager.
why: Akien 2026-10-05 (/home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md 8g): the web server unit leak — 'i don't care which way we deal with it. as long as it gets fixed'. The lived symptom: proof runs leave cairn-proof-loop units running and cairn-proof-web units failed in the live user manager (measured 2026-10-06 01:35Z: cairn-proof-loop-1637418-2 running, cairn-proof-web-1637418-{1,2,3} failed), because systemd-run hands a unit the manager's environment and bf3c16162827's kill cannot find what carries no test id.
traces_to: Test against live, marked as testing (ruled 2026-09-28, 2026-10-04: every test output carries a testing mark so it can be thrown away); bf3c16162827 (a tester run owns what it started); Law 7 (outside a run a failed live unit keeps its failed state where a human looks); RULE 1 (the change lives in launchers, the component that spawns the units)
how: launchers/superclaude builds one array _sc_test_mark before its loop block: empty outside a run; when CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID is set it holds --setenv=CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID=<id> and -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed. Both _sc_loop_start and _sc_web_start splice it after --unit. bf3c16162827's kill_what_it_started (a /proc environ scan) then reaches the unit's process, and a unit that failed (no process left) is garbage-collected by the manager. Proof launchers/proofs/test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py, written red 1/4 at d2771437.
falsifier: GREEN when launchers/proofs/test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py prints four ok lines and exits 0: (1) the ground-loop unit superclaude starts with CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID set carries that id in its main process environment; (2) that unit killed with SIGKILL, and the web unit whose listener fails to bind, are both gone from the user manager afterwards; (3) `cairn test --timeout 25` over launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py leaves no cairn-proof-* unit it created; (4) with no test id the ground-loop unit carries none and keeps CollectMode 'inactive'; and launchers/proofs/test_bootstrap.py, launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py, launchers/proofs/test_superclaude_wire.py, launchers/proofs/test_superclaude_memory_scope.py, launchers/proofs/test_launchers_reach_into_no_device.py, launchers/proofs/test_launchers_probes_report_to_the_watch.py stay green. RED if any fails. Wrong intent if a unit started inside a test run must outlive the run (then the mark becomes a declared keep-list).

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: apply exactly the unified diff carried in this ticket's build_patch field (`git apply` from a file holding that text, run in the cairn repo root). It edits only launchers/superclaude: before the systemd-run blocks it builds an array _sc_test_mark, empty unless CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID is set, in which case it holds --setenv=CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID=<id> and -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed; the array is expanded into both the ground-loop unit's and the web unit's systemd-run argv. No other code changes.

D2: SETTLED: the proof launchers/proofs/test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py is already on disk, committed red at d2771437 (1 of 4 at HEAD: tooth 4 green, 1-3 red). After the build it prints four ok lines and exits 0; the regression proofs launchers/proofs/test_bootstrap.py, launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py, launchers/proofs/test_superclaude_wire.py, launchers/proofs/test_superclaude_memory_scope.py, launchers/proofs/test_launchers_reach_into_no_device.py, launchers/proofs/test_launchers_probes_report_to_the_watch.py each exit 0.
